name: Tenstorrent Wormhole n150 / n300 new (direct)

notes: The only genuinely purchasable open-source-stack exotic accelerator - tt-metal/TT-Metalium is genuinely Apache-2.0, documented, has a bounty program. Vendor-measured Llama-3.1-8B 26.0 t/s/u (832 t/s agg b32) on n150 (record comm-tt-wormhole-n150-llama31-8b-decode). ~26 t/s for an 8B is usable chat but roughly RTX-3090-Q4 territory - you pay ~$1k for the open stack + a learnable architecture, NOT for beating a used GPU on $/tok. Blackhole p150 $1,399 / p100a $999 (32 GB, stronger). Used supply is thin.
